## Model:(logit) spline time effect without tissue
```{r}
library(limma)
library(splines)

df_spline <- 3

time_num <- c(d0=0, d0.25=0.25, d0.5=0.5, d1=1, d2=2, d3=3, d5=5)[as.character(tp)]
stopifnot(!any(is.na(time_num)))

# Option 2: spline(time) only
design_noT <- model.matrix(~ ns(time_num, df = df_spline), data = samples_sub)
colnames(design_noT) <- make.names(colnames(design_noT))

fit_noT <- lmFit(Y, design_noT)
fit_noT <- eBayes(fit_noT, trend = TRUE)

# joint F-test: "any time effect" (all spline basis terms)
time_cols <- grep("^ns\\.", colnames(design_noT))
res_time_noT <- topTable(fit_noT, coef = time_cols, number = Inf, sort.by = "F")
res_time_noT$topic <- rownames(res_time_noT)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

invlogit <- function(x) 1/(1+exp(-x))

alpha <- 0.05
sig_topics <- rownames(res_time_noT)[res_time_noT$adj.P.Val < alpha]

tgrid <- seq(0, 5, length.out = 200)
newdat <- data.frame(time_num = tgrid)

# prediction design must match model (no tissue)
Xnew <- model.matrix(~ ns(time_num, df = df_spline), data = newdat)
colnames(Xnew) <- make.names(colnames(Xnew))

# align columns (good practice)
common_cols <- intersect(colnames(Xnew), colnames(fit_noT$coefficients))
Xnew2 <- Xnew[, common_cols, drop = FALSE]
B2    <- fit_noT$coefficients[, common_cols, drop = FALSE]

pred_logit <- B2[sig_topics, , drop = FALSE] %*% t(Xnew2)
pred_theta <- invlogit(pred_logit)

plot_df <- cbind(newdat, as.data.frame(t(pred_theta)))

plot_long <- plot_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(sig_topics), names_to = "topic", values_to = "theta_hat")

```

```{r}
all_topics <- rownames(fit_noT$coefficients)   # e.g. T1..T14 (matches Y rownames)

pred_logit_all <- B2[all_topics, , drop = FALSE] %*% t(Xnew2)
pred_theta_all <- invlogit(pred_logit_all)

plot_df_all <- cbind(newdat, as.data.frame(t(pred_theta_all)))
plot_long_all <- plot_df_all %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(all_topics), names_to = "topic", values_to = "theta_hat") %>%
  mutate(sig = topic %in% sig_topics)
ggplot(plot_long_all, aes(x = time_num, y = theta_hat)) +
  geom_line(aes(color = sig, linewidth = sig)) +
  facet_wrap(~ topic, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "red", `FALSE` = "grey60"),
                     name = paste0("FDR < ", alpha)) +
  scale_linewidth_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 1.3, `FALSE` = 0.7),
                         guide = "none") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    title = "Spline trajectories",
    x = "Time (days)",
    y = "Estimated topic proportion (topic vs rest)"
  )
```

```{r}
## plot log odds differences
# predict on logit scale for all topics
pred_logit_all <- B2[all_topics, , drop = FALSE] %*% t(Xnew2)   # topics x grid

# choose baseline time t0 (e.g. d0 = 0 days)
t0 <- 0
i0 <- which.min(abs(tgrid - t0))

# delta logit vs baseline: "logFC-like" curve
delta_logit_all <- pred_logit_all - pred_logit_all[, i0]

# long df for ggplot
plot_df_delta <- cbind(time_num = tgrid, as.data.frame(t(delta_logit_all)))
plot_long_delta <- plot_df_delta %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(all_topics), names_to = "topic", values_to = "delta_logit") %>%
  mutate(sig = topic %in% sig_topics)

ggplot(plot_long_delta, aes(x = time_num, y = delta_logit)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(aes(color = sig, linewidth = sig)) +
  facet_wrap(~ topic, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE`="red", `FALSE`="grey60"),
                     name = paste0("FDR < ", alpha)) +
  scale_linewidth_manual(values = c(`TRUE`=1.3, `FALSE`=0.7), guide = "none") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    title = "Spline time effect on logit scale (Δ log-odds vs d0)",
    x = "Time (days)",
    y = "Δ logit(topic vs rest) relative to d0"
  )
```
# Model: (logit) spline time effect with tissue

```{r}
library(limma)
library(splines)

df_spline <- 3

time_num <- c(d0=0, d0.25=0.25, d0.5=0.5, d1=1, d2=2, d3=3, d5=5)[as.character(tp)]
stopifnot(!any(is.na(time_num)))

design_B <- model.matrix(
  ~ 0 + tissue + tissue:ns(time_num, df = df_spline),
  data = samples_sub
)
colnames(design_B) <- make.names(colnames(design_B))

fit_B <- lmFit(Y, design_B)
fit_B <- eBayes(fit_B, trend = TRUE)

# test: any time variation in any tissue (joint F-test over all tissue-specific spline terms)
time_cols <- grep("^tissue.*ns\\.", colnames(design_B))
res_time_B <- topTable(fit_B, coef = time_cols, number = Inf, sort.by = "F")
res_time_B$topic <- rownames(res_time_B)

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

invlogit <- function(x) 1/(1+exp(-x))

alpha <- 0.05
sig_topics <- rownames(res_time_B)[res_time_B$adj.P.Val < alpha]

tgrid   <- seq(0, 5, length.out = 200)
tissues <- levels(samples_sub$tissue)

newdat <- expand.grid(time_num = tgrid, tissue = tissues)
newdat$tissue <- factor(newdat$tissue, levels = tissues)

# IMPORTANT: prediction design must match Model B
Xnew <- model.matrix(
  ~ 0 + tissue + tissue:ns(time_num, df = df_spline),
  data = newdat
)
colnames(Xnew) <- make.names(colnames(Xnew))

# align columns (important safety step)
common_cols <- intersect(colnames(Xnew), colnames(fit_B$coefficients))
Xnew2 <- Xnew[, common_cols, drop = FALSE]
B2    <- fit_B$coefficients[, common_cols, drop = FALSE]

# predict logits -> proportions
pred_logit <- B2[sig_topics, , drop = FALSE] %*% t(Xnew2)
pred_theta <- invlogit(pred_logit)

plot_df <- cbind(newdat, as.data.frame(t(pred_theta)))

plot_long <- plot_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(sig_topics), names_to = "topic", values_to = "theta_hat")

```

```{r}
tissues_all <- levels(samples_sub$tissue)
tissues_1 <- tissues_all[1:6]
tissues_2 <- tissues_all[7:length(tissues_all)]

p1 <- ggplot(subset(plot_long, tissue %in% tissues_1),
             aes(x = time_num, y = theta_hat, color = tissue)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  facet_wrap(~ topic, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(
    title = "Model B: tissue-specific spline trajectories (Tissues 1–6)",
    x = "Time (days)",
    y = "Estimated topic proportion (topic vs rest)",
    color = "Tissue"
  )

p2 <- ggplot(subset(plot_long, tissue %in% tissues_2),
             aes(x = time_num, y = theta_hat, color = tissue)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  facet_wrap(~ topic, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(
    title = "Model B: tissue-specific spline trajectories (Tissues 7–13)",
    x = "Time (days)",
    y = "Estimated topic proportion (topic vs rest)",
    color = "Tissue"
  )

p1
p2
```

    y = "Logit(topic vs rest)",

  )

p1_logit

  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(
    title = "Model B: tissue-specific spline trajectories (logit scale, tissues 7–13)",
    x = "Time (days)",
    y = "Logit(topic vs rest)",
    color = "Tissue"
  )

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# --- split tissues into two sets ---
tissues_all <- levels(samples_sub$tissue)
tissues_1 <- tissues_all[1:6]
tissues_2 <- tissues_all[7:length(tissues_all)]

# --- split topics into two sets of 7 ---
topics_all <- sort(unique(plot_long$topic))
topics_1 <- topics_all[1:7]
topics_2 <- topics_all[8:14]

# helper to plot one panel set
plot_tissue_topic <- function(tissues_keep, topics_keep, title_txt) {
  df <- subset(plot_long, tissue %in% tissues_keep & topic %in% topics_keep)

  df$topic  <- factor(df$topic, levels = topics_keep)
  df$tissue <- factor(df$tissue, levels = tissues_keep)

  ggplot(df, aes(x = time_num, y = theta_hat, color = topic)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.1, alpha = 0.9) +
    facet_wrap(~ tissue, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
    labs(
      title = title_txt,
      x = "Time (days)",
      y = "Estimated topic proportion",
      color = "Topic"
    )
}

p11 <- plot_tissue_topic(tissues_1, topics_1, "Tissues 1–6 | Topics 1–7")
p12 <- plot_tissue_topic(tissues_1, topics_2, "Tissues 1–6 | Topics 8–14")
p21 <- plot_tissue_topic(tissues_2, topics_1, "Tissues 7–13 | Topics 1–7")
p22 <- plot_tissue_topic(tissues_2, topics_2, "Tissues 7–13 | Topics 8–14")

p11
p12
p21
p22
```
